reddit.title: Improved Audio Experience in Provincia: Soft Music Reloops
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the audio experience in Provincia! Music transitions between day, night, title, and combat beds now feature a seamless crossfade, eliminating the awkward hard cuts. This enhancement ensures a smoother and more immersive experience as you build your colony. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Audio Enhancements in Provincia: Soft Music Reloops
